assistant_title: Nagoya Precision Components Maintenance Knowledge Assistant
input_placeholder: 故障・メンテナンス・SOPに関する質問を日本語または英語で入力してください... (例: ALM-204が発生した場合の手順は？)
interaction_modes: Type a natural language question in Japanese or simple English.
Receive an answer with numbered steps and source citations.
Expand evidence cards to view original document excerpts.
For escalated cases, a reviewer sees a notification and can approve, edit, or reject the draft.
View audit log of all interactions for compliance.

user_actions.label: Ask question
user_actions.description: Submit a maintenance or SOP query to retrieve evidence-based answers.

user_actions.label: View evidence sources
user_actions.description: Open and read the original documents that support the answer.

user_actions.label: Flag for supervisor review
user_actions.description: Escalate the current response for human review if unsure or safety-critical.

user_actions.label: Approve or reject escalated response (reviewer only)
user_actions.description: As a reviewer, approve the draft or request changes before it is finalized.

user_actions.label: Edit answer draft (reviewer only)
user_actions.description: Modify the assistant's draft to add context or correct information.

user_actions.label: Export conversation for record-keeping
user_actions.description: Save the full chat thread and evidence for compliance and audit purposes.

conversation_starters: NC旋盤のALM-204が出た場合、最初に確認すべき手順は何ですか？
検査寸法が連続して外れた場合、どのSOPを確認すべきですか？
新人オペレーター向けに、工具交換前の安全確認を簡単に説明してください。
このアラームはライン停止と上長承認が必要ですか？
マシニングセンタの工具折れが疑われる場合のトラブルシューティング手順を教えてください。
品質検査のチェックリストで、寸法公差が外れた場合の記録手順は？
機械の安全インターロックを無効にしてはならない理由を教えてください。
safety_notice: This AI assistant provides technical support based on approved documents. It does not replace professional judgment. Safety-critical actions, machine restarts, and bypass of interlocks require human supervisor approval. Always verify steps and escalate when unsure.
response_contract: Every response will provide cited evidence, flag missing information, and indicate if human approval is required. No answer will authorize unsafe actions.
